          About this item

          • Quickly Locate Items - Compatible with Apple Find My: Works seamlessly with the Apple Find My app (iOS/iPadOS/macOS only). No need to download third-party, ad-heavy apps. Enjoy global tracking network with absolutely no monthly subscriptions or hidden costs.
          • 100dB Loud Alarm for Quick Search: Equipped with an upgraded high-decibel buzzer. Simply tap "Play Sound" on your phone, and the 100dB loud alarm will easily guide you to your lost keys or wallet, even in noisy outdoor environments or when buried under clothes.
          • Robust & Reliable: Designed for everyday use, GPS tracker is water and dust resistant (IP68 rated), giving you peace of mind that it will withstand various environments. Enjoy up to a 350-foot range and a battery life that lasts up to three years without needing a replacement.
          • Ultra-Thin & Multi-Scenario Fit: The coin-sized, lightweight design comes with a built-in lanyard hole. Easily attach it to your keychains, luggage, backpack, or pet dog/cat collar without adding any bulk. Perfect for travelers, students, and pet owners.
          • Cost-Effective 4-Pack Choice: Share the security with your family! A highly affordable alternative offering the same premium tracking experience. The 4-pack set is the ultimate budget-friendly solution for multi-item tracking.
          • Solid Gift Idea: Surprise your loved ones with the ideal gift! This set of four smart bluetooth tracker tags makes a thoughtful present for anyone who tends to misplace items. Great for family, friends, or even your pets; keep everyone connected and secure.
          • Instructions: Make sure your phone's Bluetooth and network are turned on. Press and hold the power button on the side of the tracker for 3 seconds, and release it when you hear a 'beep.' Then open the **Find My** app on your iPhone's home screen. In the app, tap **Add Item**, and choose **Other Supported Item**. Select a name and icon to complete the connection. To add a second device, first press and hold the power button on the side of the second tracker for 3 seconds, release it when you hear a 'beep,' then you must tap the "+ " on your phone screen and choose to add another item,and continue to complete the connection.

              • Do I need to pay a monthly subscription fee to use this tracker?

                No, not at all! This smart tag works directly with the native Apple Find My app. There are absolutely no third-party apps to download and zero hidden monthly fees.

              • Does this tracker work with Android phones like Samsung?

                No. This locator tag is exclusively designed for iOS devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac) to ensure seamless integration with the Apple Find My network.

              • Is the alarm loud enough if I lose my keys under the couch?

                Yes! We upgraded the built-in buzzer to an 100dB loud alarm, which is noticeably louder than many basic trackers. You can easily hear it even if it's buried under cushions or clothes.

              • Can I use this for my dog's collar when it rains?

                Absolutely. It features an IP67 waterproof rating, meaning it can withstand heavy rain and even short-term submersion in water, making it perfect for pets and outdoor use.

              • Is the battery replaceable?

                Absolutely, this tracker runs on replaceable CR2032 coin‑cell batteries, you can easily replace them by yourself.

              About this Item

              • Quickly Locate Items - Compatible with Apple Find My: Works seamlessly with the Apple Find My app (iOS/iPadOS/macOS only). No need to download third-party, ad-heavy apps. Enjoy global tracking network with absolutely no monthly subscriptions or hidden costs.
              • 100dB Loud Alarm for Quick Search: Equipped with an upgraded high-decibel buzzer. Simply tap "Play Sound" on your phone, and the 100dB loud alarm will easily guide you to your lost keys or wallet, even in noisy outdoor environments or when buried under clothes.
              • Robust & Reliable: Designed for everyday use, GPS tracker is water and dust resistant (IP68 rated), giving you peace of mind that it will withstand various environments. Enjoy up to a 350-foot range and a battery life that lasts up to three years without needing a replacement.
              • Ultra-Thin & Multi-Scenario Fit: The coin-sized, lightweight design comes with a built-in lanyard hole. Easily attach it to your keychains, luggage, backpack, or pet dog/cat collar without adding any bulk. Perfect for travelers, students, and pet owners.
              • Cost-Effective 4-Pack Choice: Share the security with your family! A highly affordable alternative offering the same premium tracking experience. The 4-pack set is the ultimate budget-friendly solution for multi-item tracking.
              • Solid Gift Idea: Surprise your loved ones with the ideal gift! This set of four smart bluetooth tracker tags makes a thoughtful present for anyone who tends to misplace items. Great for family, friends, or even your pets; keep everyone connected and secure.
              • Instructions: Make sure your phone's Bluetooth and network are turned on. Press and hold the power button on the side of the tracker for 3 seconds, and release it when you hear a 'beep.' Then open the **Find My** app on your iPhone's home screen. In the app, tap **Add Item**, and choose **Other Supported Item**. Select a name and icon to complete the connection. To add a second device, first press and hold the power button on the side of the second tracker for 3 seconds, release it when you hear a 'beep,' then you must tap the "+ " on your phone screen and choose to add another item,and continue to complete the connection.
